Expose draw_into_bgra for opaque caller-owned pixel buffers, sharing the same
Skia painting and text settings as the retained offscreen implementation.
Manifest dependencies use the original fixed git revision. Licenses retained.

Reuse each thread's system font manager and empty-asset font collection for
measurement, painting and SVG icons, retaining custom font asset behavior.
